title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37918v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning across videos requires aligning events, matching identities, comparing motion, and integrating partial observations. Evaluating these capabilities and testing how to improve them requires both reliable labels and targeted supervision. We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that connects these two needs through shared task generators. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from environment state and provides 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 training questions over disjoint videos, spanning eight cross-video reasoning tasks. Visual ablations and human evaluation assess dependence on the supplied evidence and answer recoverability. Evaluation of 22 multimodal large language models reveals persistent difficulties in physical comparison and scene integration that increasing model size does not consistently resolve. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3-VL-8B's average SYNCR accuracy from 32.6%

translated_title: SYNCR：从仿真中诊断与学习跨视频推理
translated_abstract: 跨视频推理需要对齐事件、匹配身份、比较运动以及整合部分观察。要评估这些能力并测试如何改进，既需要可靠的标签，也需要有针对性的监督。我们提出了 SYNCR，这是一个基于仿真器的框架，通过共享的任务生成器将这两种需求联系起来。SYNCR 构建于 Habitat、Kubric 和 CLEVRER 之上，直接从环境状态推导答案，并在互不重叠的视频上提供了 4,000 个评估问题和 15,960 个训练问题，涵盖八项跨视频推理任务。视觉消融实验和人工评估用于衡量模型对所提供证据的依赖程度以及答案的可恢复性。对 22 个多模态大语言模型的评估表明，它们在物理比较和场景整合方面存在持续性困难，而单纯增大模型规模并不能稳定地解决这些问题。监督微调将 Qwen3-VL-8B 的平均 SYNCR 准确率从 32.6%（原文在此处截断）显著提升。
tldr: SYNCR 是一个基于仿真器的跨视频推理诊断与训练框架，通过从环境状态自动生成可靠标签，揭示了 22 个多模态大模型在物理比较和场景整合上的持续短板，并证明监督微调可显著提升跨视频推理能力。
en_tdlr: SYNCR is a simulator-grounded framework for diagnosing and training cross-video reasoning that derives reliable labels from environment state, revealing persistent weaknesses of 22 multimodal LLMs in physical comparison and scene integration, and showing that supervised fine-tuning substantially improves performance.
